intensity.docs: The intensity of the screen can be set "dynamically" with this action.

invert_on.docs: This action `max7219digit.invert_on` will invert the display. So background pixels are on and text pixels are off. `max7219digit.invert_off` sets the display back to normal. The background pixels are only set at the next update, the pixels drawn in the various functions like print, line, etc. are directly influenced by the invert command.

reverse_on.docs: With these actions you can reverse the display direction from left-to-right to right-to-left.

turn_on.docs: The display can be switched on and off "dynamically" with the actions `max7219digit.turn_on` / `max7219digit.turn_off`.

chip_lines_style.docs:
How are the lines in Multiline Mode connected? Possible values are `zigzag` and `snake`. Defaults to `snake`

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

cs_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin you have the CS line hooked up to.

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

flip_x.docs:
**boolean**: Flip the horizontal axis on the screen. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

intensity.docs:
**int**: The intensity with which the MAX7219 should drive the outputs. Range is from `0`, least intense to `15` the brightest. Defaults to `15`.

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

num_chip_lines.docs:
**int**: Number of lines if you want to use the displays in Multiline Mode. Defaults to `1` Example: [https://github.com/esphome/esphome/pull/1622#issue-836179156](https://github.com/esphome/esphome/pull/1622#issue-836179156)

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

num_chips.docs:
**int**: The number of chips you wish to use for daisy chaining. Defaults to `4`.

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

reverse_enable.docs:
**boolean**: For some displays the order of the displays is reversed ("DCBA"). This option will reverse the display to ("ABCD") again. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

rotate_chip.docs:
Rotates every 8x8 chip. Valid values are `0`, `90`, `180` and `270`. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

scroll_delay.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Set delay time before scroll starts. Defaults to `1s`.

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

scroll_dwell.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Sets the wait time at the end of the scroll before starting over. This is only used in mode `STOP`. Defaults to `1s`.

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

scroll_enable.docs:
**boolean**: Turn scroll mode on when content does not fit. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

scroll_mode.docs:
Set the scroll mode. One of `CONTINUOUS` or `STOP`. Defaults to `CONTINUOUS`

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

scroll_speed.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Set scroll speed. Defaults to `250ms`

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

spi_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [SPI Component](https://esphome.io/components/spi) if you want to use multiple SPI buses.

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to re-draw the screen. Defaults to `1s`.

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*

lambda.docs:
**[lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)**: The lambda to use for rendering the content on the MAX7219. See [Rendering Lambda](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#display-max7219digit_lambda) for more information.

*See also: [MAX7219 Digit Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219digit#configuration-variables)*
